summary: Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed covering Nifty dashboard, fund search/detail, watchlist CRUD (incl. duplicate rejection), portfolio CRUD + invested/current/pnl math, alerts check/list/mark-all-read, settings GET/PATCH, SIP and Lumpsum future-value math, and best-buys sorting. Frontend: Dashboard renders Nifty card (NAV ₹168.23, +1.35%), portfolio summary, opportunity widget and SIP/Lumpsum tool links. SIP & Lumpsum calculators compute and show result cards. Settings opens and persists threshold updates. Watchlist add (via search), target-price modal (Target ₹50.00 displayed), and remove flow all work. Portfolio add-holding flow updates total (₹1,657.24 after adding 10 units of UTI Nifty fund). Alerts tab shows empty state with 'Check now' button. Fund detail screen loads with 7/30/90 day range toggles and both Add to Watchlist / Add to Portfolio buttons.

minor.issue: Returns 200 even if alert id does not exist (inconsistent with watchlist/portfolio delete which return 404). Minor consistency issue.

action_items: (Optional) Make DELETE /api/alerts/{id} return 404 when id not found for consistency with other delete endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: list_watchlist/best-buys/portfolio make N+1 calls to mfapi.in per request (one per scheme). Acceptable for single-user app with small N but could be batched/cached for scalability.

Background alert loop runs every 30 min — fine; first run sleeps 15s after startup so a manual /api/alerts/check is required to seed alerts immediately (already wired from frontend on mount and on Alerts pull-to-refresh).

Alert.alert in react-native-web (used in watchlist/portfolio remove confirmation, fund detail, settings save) does not trigger as a native dialog inside automated browser tests. This does not affect the real mobile experience but means the remove-confirmation step cannot be auto-confirmed via Playwright dialog handler.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed watchlist + portfolio rows for scheme 120716 (UTI Nifty 50). No leftover data after tests complete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_mf_tracker_api.py can be reused as regression. Frontend tab navigation via text= clicks is unreliable on react-native-web tabs; use direct URL navigation (e.g. /watchlist, /portfolio, /alerts) or rely on testIDs. Register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` for any future alert handling.
